description: Optional schedules, reminders and internal event-triggered agent tasks.

settings.label: Allow Recurring Schedules
settings.hint: ON (default) lets the agent create repeating cron schedules (every morning at 9, every Monday) as well as one-shot tasks. OFF restricts it to one-shot tasks only (a reminder in 10 minutes, a job at a fixed time). Recurring jobs keep running until paused or cancelled, so turn this off if you don't want the agent setting up jobs that fire on their own indefinitely.

settings.label: Allow Event Triggers
settings.hint: Allows subscriptions to supported internal run/session events. External email, file and messaging event adapters are unavailable in v3.

settings.label: Max Automations per User
settings.hint: The total number of scheduled tasks plus event triggers this agent will keep alive for one user at a time. Once the ceiling is hit, new schedule/subscribe requests are refused until the user cancels some. Stops an agent from quietly piling up hundreds of background jobs.

settings.label: Max Fires per Day (event triggers)
settings.hint: A daily ceiling on how many times a single event trigger may fire. A noisy source (a busy inbox, a chatty channel) could otherwise wake the agent hundreds of times a day; this caps the per-day spend. The agent may request a lower cap per trigger, but never a higher one than this.

settings.label: Max Delivery Targets
settings.hint: Caps result destinations. This module currently accepts exactly one explicit destination: an existing conversation, a new conversation or silent execution. External delivery adapters are unavailable.

settings.label: Require Human Approval
settings.hint: ON makes every automation the agent creates start PAUSED — a person must switch it on from the Automation tab before it will ever run. Use this when you want the agent to propose schedules and triggers but never arm them by itself. OFF (default) lets the agent's automations start running immediately.

migration_note: Optional standalone Rust engine. Internal events, schedules, reminders and host-admitted chat/silent runs are implemented; adapter integrations remain unavailable. Installation and acceptance are required before callable availability.
